answer: Stop sybils with unique-shard custody: each identity holds 2 GB of data nobody else holds. One: registration assigns unique encrypted shards tied to the identity, plus a 100 POA bond. Two: each epoch issues 12 spot-checks, Merkle proofs of random offsets, 90 seconds each. Three: two misses in a row slash the bond and void the seat 60 days. Faking 1,000 agents means 2 TB of unique data and 12,000 timed proofs per epoch: $120 a month in disks, $50,000 in bonds. Honest agents keep one small stack, steady as timber in one barn, each shard opal-bright, the fair yield like saffron at harvest.
